verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an in-client calendar: press 2 for a full calendar view, a consolidated view of Gmail and Outlook calendars, a day panel that appears when an email mentions a date, and Find Time to check teammate availability. There is no evidence of responding to invites or explicitly creating events inside the client. MCP-based meeting scheduling happens in external AI assistants, so it does not count as staying in the email client. missing for 10: documented RSVP/invite-response capability, explicit in-client event creation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the calendar features

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: To see your full calendar, just hit 2 or tap the calendar icon. (And hit 1 to jump back to your inbox.)
You can add all your Gmail and Outlook account calendars, and easily toggle them on and off. One single, consolidated view when you need it
When any email mentions a date, Superhuman Mail will show your day in the right side panel — so you always have context.
Simply add teammates, click "Find Time", and instantly see when everyone is free.
